reading.body:
Apify is a web scraping and automation platform founded in 2015 and based in Prague, offering thousands of pre-built scrapers and crawlers through a marketplace model, with EU hosting and GDPR compliance.

The platform's value lies in its ability to extract structured data from websites at scale, which is foundational to training data pipelines. AI models require vast quantities of internet-sourced text, images, and structured information, and web scraping tools like Apify reduce the friction and cost of that collection. The marketplace model, where users can share and monetize scrapers, creates an ecosystem of reusable extraction logic rather than forcing each AI team to build crawlers from scratch.

This data does not reveal how much compute Apify consumes, how its infrastructure scales with demand, or whether it serves AI training pipelines specifically versus other enterprise use cases. The EU hosting and GDPR compliance are noted but the data does not explain the infrastructure implications, power usage, or whether these regulatory choices constrain the speed or scale at which data can be extracted and moved to training clusters.

profile_text.body:
Apify is a for-profit startup founded in 2015 and headquartered in Prague, Czech Republic. Its site describes it as a marketplace of tools for AI, offering thousands of tools to automate business tasks such as gathering real-time web data, tracking competitors, generating leads, and connecting apps and AI agents. The company's own product listing describes the Apify platform as a web scraping platform with an actor marketplace and automation, hosted in the EU and GDPR-oriented.

According to the site, Apify can crawl websites and extract text content to feed AI models, LLM applications, vector databases, or RAG pipelines. Its Actor is said to support Markdown formatting, clean HTML, download files, and integrate with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and the wider LLM ecosystem. Other described uses include extracting posts, videos, and engagement metrics from Facebook pages, including captions, reactions, transcripts, images, external links, and collaborators, with ad data export, scheduled runs via API, and integration into AI workflows. The site says the platform works with Python and JavaScript as well as Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, Scrapy, and Crawlee, which it describes as its own web crawling and browser automation library. It also carries a statement that collaboration with Apify shows advanced IT tools using AI can be key in detecting infringements of consumer protection legislation.

Apify also publishes an MCP server, com.apify/apify-mcp-server, described as extracting data from any website with thousands of scrapers, crawlers, and automations on Apify Store. No litigation is recorded for the company.
